Cross-sectional momentum is display-only (validated as rank-IC ~0), the absolute-trend gate is the one validated risk-control leg (gate_helps=true), and rotation timing has no forward edge, so this note is directional humility, not prediction. Track record (n=147, dir_accuracy 0.313) is a large sample with weak directional skill — conviction must default low.

The observable condition that would retire this watch is XEG.TO crossing into eligible=true (absolute-trend gate passed) with durability_bar above 0.5 and breadth above 0.6 — a confirmed handoff, not a predicted one.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks are the only theme that clears every discipline leg simultaneously: rank 1, eligible (absolute-trend gate passed), durability 0.8 (trend, high), breadth 1.0 (full participation), not crowded (z 0.7). This is the theoretical staying-power set-up: the gate is the one validated risk-control edge, and breadth/cohesion support narrative durability. The lean is expressed as a conditional preference, not a return forecast.
evidence: gate_helps=true (absolute-trend gate is the validated risk-control leg)
theses.dissent: Momentum rank itself has rank-IC ~0, so leadership status is an attention lens, not alpha; Big Banks could simply be the last crowded consensus trade and mean-revert while the gate materially reduces drawdown but adds no return edge.

theses.subject: Utilities & Renewables
theses.thesis: Utilities & Renewables are the quiet staying-power candidate: eligible, durability 0.8 (trend), breadth 0.917, and the least crowded eligible theme (crowding_z -0.25). With the absolute-trend gate validated for drawdown control and this theme showing trend + high breadth + low crowding, it fits the discipline's de-risk preference without chasing the leader. This is a diversification-flavoured lean, not an alpha call.
theses.dissent: The theme's low score (0.4 vs leader 1.018) means weak relative momentum; the absolute-trend gate controls risk but has no mean-return edge, so this could be a low-volatility sideways grind with no follow-through.

theses.subject: Technology
theses.thesis: Technology is the crowded theme (crowding_z 1.18, crowded=true) with mixed hurst, breadth 0.8 but negative score (-0.247) and rank 13. Per guardrails, crowding is a size-down caution only — but with the theme already low in rank and crowded, the discipline argues for avoiding it rather than adding. This is not a fade or short; it is a staying-away lean.
evidence: guardrails: crowding is a size-down caution, never a fade
theses.dissent: Crowding has no basket-level forward edge and can persist reflexively; avoiding a crowded theme with a still-positive durability_bar (0.66) could mean missing continued upside if the trend reasserts.
